verdict.rationale: Gusto's docs explicitly claim multi-location/multi-state support, automatic tax calculation and filing, and handling of multi-state tax requirements as core platform features (docs-31, docs-44, docs-45). However, this evidence is primarily vendor documentation rather than hands-on validation, and community feedback raises real concerns about tax/compliance execution issues (W-2 corrections, double-reported payroll to IRS, healthcare/benefits mismanagement across states) that undercut confidence in flawless multi-state compliance.
